notes: Both controllers use the same merged rule engine, including shared height-dependent siege, counterattack and threat-range fixes.
The primary acceptance is tactic vs tactic. Advanced is a separate secondary check; its conservative lower bound fails the declared gate.
Unresolved games score zero wins. Pair is the independent sampling unit. Final validation seeds were not used for tuning.
Industrial and volcanic subgroups remain weak. Per-profile samples are small.
Lead labels in advanced telemetry describe inactive situational preferences; all three doctrine drives are zero.
Abandonment records indicate a decision, not necessarily the actual loss of a city. Whole-game development is not causal post-abandonment attribution.
The new controller retries rejected candidates within the same 50-decision budget. The frozen controller retains its original stop-on-rejection behavior.

tactic.acceptance: At least 32 independent seed pairs; observed wins / ALL games >= 60%; paired bootstrap and one-sided distribution-free Hoeffding 95% lower bounds > 50%. Unresolved are not draws or wins.

advanced.acceptance: At least 32 independent seed pairs; observed wins / ALL games >= 60%; paired bootstrap and one-sided distribution-free Hoeffding 95% lower bounds > 50%. Unresolved are not draws or wins.

selfCheck.acceptance: At least 32 independent seed pairs; observed wins / ALL games >= 60%; paired bootstrap and one-sided distribution-free Hoeffding 95% lower bounds > 50%. Unresolved are not draws or wins.
